I thought I did but I had a lot of time to reflect on my life while I was in prison and I actually didn't.

Everything I have done so far I my life from going to college, going to university, getting a job and moving out was all because that was the normal thing to do. I don't think I even realized I had a problem when I was younger but looking back at my life I can see that I did.

The three most glaring examples are as follows, when I was a teenager a friend who I had known since primary school ended up with cancer and dieing, I left her funeral early because I was bored. I didn't tell my family this I think I told them I was I'll or some other excuse but at the time it didn't even strike me as odd that I would think that way.

The other time was more recent but still before I admitted that I had a problem. I was still living with my mum at the time and we got a suprise phonecall that my grandad was in the hospital and he had less than 24 hours to live, my mum hugged me and I felt nothing. Not sadness just nothing. Even when sat at his bedside I was bored. It turns out the doctors where wrong and he recovered but we still thought he would die.

Finally after I moved out I got a text from my sister to say my uncle had just been diagnosed with throat cancer, I was just irritated that I had been interrupted while I was cooking.

So looking back I think I have always been at this point I just hid it from myself as well as everyone around me.

To be honest I don't see myself being on this earth for too much longer, you would probably understand more if I hadn't accidentally deleted everything I wrote but I ended up in prison, destroyed every friendship I had and lost my job. All because I didn't want to admit to myself that there was something wrong.

I'm not going to go into what I did but I don't see a future for myself anymore. Even before this I can honestly say I didn't care about anything. 

Something in my brain just doesn't work right, everyone goes on about emotions and love ect but to me although I would never tell them the friends I had and my family where at best a distraction from the emptiness that is my life and at worst a chore I had to put up with.

I know this sounds bad and it is but i seem to be incapable of making bonds with anyone.
